title: Section
description: Adds a section to a page of a landing, from the standard kinds: hero, page-hero, logos, cards, split, faq, prose, final-cta, page-cta. Writes the section component in src/views/<page>/sections/, its copy in both languages under <page>.<id>, and lists it in the page (before the closing call to action). Mark the highlighted words of a hero or final-cta title with *asterisks*.

page.description: The page (its folder in src/views): home, or one made with `add page`

kind.description: hero: the home's h1 with two calls to action. page-hero: a subpage's h1. logos: a band of logo tiles. cards: a grid of cards with icon dots. split: an image beside points with icons. faq: questions and answers with FAQPage data. prose: running text. final-cta: the ink closing band. page-cta: a subpage's quiet closing card

id.description: Unique in the page: names the component and the copy key (defaults to the kind)

eyebrowEn.description: Small label above the title, in English

titleEn.description: Title in English; in a hero or final-cta, *asterisks* mark the highlighted words

deckEn.description: The sentence under the title, in English

deckEs.description: The sentence under the title, in Spanish

itemsEn.description: cards and split: "Title|Body" per item; faq: "Question|Answer"; prose: one paragraph per item. One quoted value per item (commas stay in the text): --items-en "Fast|Set up in a day, not a month." "Clear|One place."

itemsEs.description: The same items in Spanish, in the same order

primaryEn.description: Label of the main button (hero, final-cta, page-cta), in English

primaryEs.description: Label of the main button, in Spanish

secondaryEn.description: Label of the second button, in English

secondaryEs.description: Label of the second button, in Spanish

secondaryPath.description: Page the second button opens, without the locale (e.g. /pricing)

icons.description: Material icons of the items, in order, as in Google's catalog in kebab-case (e.g. verified-user, receipt-long)

tone.description: Background of cards, split and prose (dark only for cards)

image.description: Image under public/ for hero, page-hero and split (e.g. /images/hero.webp, made with `npm run gen:images`)

imageAltEn.description: What the image shows, in English

imageAltEs.description: What the image shows, in Spanish

replace.description: Write the section again when it exists: component and copy (needs --yes)

itemsEs: Por qué|Cada decisión guarda su razón.
